driver_generation_rules: Driver code may rely on `kernel::pci`, `kernel::miscdevice`, `kernel::uaccess`, and `kernel::mm::virt` only through the artifact-approved surfaces.
Keep PCI registration, miscdevice registration, user-copy, page ownership, BAR mapping, and PFN/VMA mapping details inside abstractions; driver code must not call raw helpers directly.
Only enable `ioctl` / `compat_ioctl` / `mmap` once the corresponding abstraction obligations are explicitly discharged in the generated artifacts.

driver_side_rules: Do not use `unsafe` in driver code, including `unsafe impl`, `unsafe fn`, or `unsafe {}` blocks.
Do not reference `bindings::*` directly from driver code; route constants and types through approved abstractions.
Do not perform raw BAR mapping, raw miscdevice registration, raw page allocation/address translation, or raw user-copy calls inside the driver surface.
Only enable `ioctl` and `mmap` through discharged abstractions for page-backed ping state, shared BAR ownership, and VMA mapping.
